### [CleanUp.ps1](file:///c%3A/.Repo/Intellicap/.devcontainer/CleanUp.ps1)

Add functionality to elevate the script to admin if not already, and perform cleanup tasks like clearing leftover files and cache after a Windows installation.

````powershell
# Check if running as Administrator
If (-Not ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal] [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole] "Administrator")) {
    Write-Host "Script is not running as Administrator. Restarting with elevated privileges..."
    Start-Process powershell.exe "-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$PSCommandPath`"" -Verb RunAs
    Exit
}

# Perform cleanup tasks
Write-Host "Performing cleanup tasks..."

# Clear temporary files
Write-Host "Clearing temporary files..."
Remove-Item -Path "$env:TEMP\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

# Clear Windows Update leftover files
Write-Host "Clearing Windows Update leftover files..."
Remove-Item -Path "C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

# Clear old Windows installation files
Write-Host "Clearing old Windows installation files..."
If (Test-Path "C:\Windows.old") {
    Remove-Item -Path "C:\Windows.old" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}

# Clear system cache
Write-Host "Clearing system cache..."
Remove-Item -Path "C:\Windows\Temp\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

Write-Host "Cleanup completed successfully."
````

# CleanUp.ps1 v0.8 - Modular Maintenance Script for Windows

# Check for Administrator Privileges
Function Test-AdminPrivileges {
    If (-Not ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal] [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole([Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole] "Administrator")) {
        Write-Host "Script not running as Administrator. Restarting..."
        Start-Process powershell.exe "-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$PSCommandPath`" @args" -Verb RunAs
        Exit
    }
}

Function Remove-SystemTempFiles {
    Write-Host "`n[+] Cleaning system temporary files..."
    Remove-Item -Path "$env:TEMP\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item -Path "C:\Windows\Temp\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Remove-Item -Path "C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    If (Test-Path "C:\Windows.old") {
        Remove-Item -Path "C:\Windows.old" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    }
}

Function Clear-TrashBin {
    Write-Host "`n[+] Emptying Recycle Bin..."
    $(New-Object -ComObject Shell.Application).NameSpace(0xA).Items() | ForEach-Object {Remove-Item $_.Path -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue}
}

# MAIN EXECUTION FLOW

} else {

        switch ($arg.ToLower()) {
            "-cleansystem"        { $actions += "Remove-SystemTempFiles" }
            "-emptyrecyclebin"    { $actions += "Clear-TrashBin" }
            "-clearbrowsercache"  { $actions += "Clear-BrowserCaches" }
            "-optimizestartup"    { $actions += "Disable-StartupPrograms" }
            "-healthcheck"        { $actions += "Test-SystemHealth" }
            "-defrag"             { $actions += "Optimize-HDD" }
            "-all"                { $doAll = $true }

} else {
